# A render slot emptied and filled again comes back where it was written, on
# gtk4 and win32 in each language: its entries go before an anchor the
# runtime keeps in the container (#[gen.protocol(anchor)]: gtk4's
# _slotAnchor, a hidden label, and win32's sngl_win32_slot_anchor, a
# hidden spacer that takes no room). Placed past the entries it held last,
# which were none, "A" went after "B" and the button.

[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/again.png

rm app.sngl.snapshots
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/again.png

rm app.sngl.snapshots
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/again.png

rm app.sngl.snapshots
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'
cmp app.sngl.snapshots/first.png app.sngl.snapshots/again.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var a = true
    ui.vbox {
        if a {
            ui.text(value="A")
        }
        ui.text(value="B")
        ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click { a = !a })
    }
}

func testFirst(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("first")
}

func testAgain(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("again")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
